title: Reef42 Marine Life Database

data_policy.null_policy: Unknown or not sufficiently supported values are null; do not infer.
data_policy.minimum_tank_size: Approximate conservative hobby guidance, not a scientifically standardized species threshold. Reassess per adult size, swimming behavior, aquascape and husbandry.
data_policy.lifespan: Wild and aquarium lifespan values are intentionally null until species-specific reliable evidence is sourced.
data_policy.ethical_index: Provisional Reef42 editorial score, not a scientific metric. Low-confidence scores are hypotheses for review, not evidence of measured mortality or lifespan. Scores must be supported by species-specific husbandry evidence before public release.
data_policy.photos: No images are stored. Sources link to external references only.
data_policy.taxonomy: Some aquarium-trade names may not map cleanly to a single species; verify identification before publishing.
data_policy.subgroups: Each species has a subgroup.id for filtering and a localized display name for category navigation.
data_policy.images: Each species has image_reference.source_page_url and image_reference.commons_search_url. These are external photo/reference pages, not guaranteed direct image binaries. Verify the license and attribution of each individual file before reuse. direct_image_url is null until a specific licensed asset is selected.
data_policy.hungarian_fish_names: Only names found in Hungarian marine-aquarium trade references or explicitly confirmed by the Reef42 team are populated. If no established name was found, hu_name is null; no literal translation is forced.
data_policy.sources: At least two external cross-check sources are attached per species where practical. Sources are mapped to supported information types; source presence does not mean every field is independently confirmed.
data_policy.pro_tips: The pro_tips key is omitted when no genuinely useful species-specific tip was identified.
